languages_frameworks: Python (single seed script using falkordb client; not pinned)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Scripted 'agent investigation' playback over three hard-coded fraud scenarios (mule ring, shell-company layering, smurfing/structuring)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each scenario carries pre-written steps with a cypher string, detail text, highlighted node/edge ids and a fixed timeMs; the UI merely steps through them on a 2.4 s timer. No query is executed and no agent or LLM exists in the repository.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Risk score / signal breakdown and draft SAR text generation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Signal scores (e.g. 35/35, 28/30) and riskScore 95 are literal constants in scenarios.js; the SAR is a template filled from the same constants. The human sign-off is a local React boolean toggle that rewrites the text 'APPROVED & SIGNED FOR SUBMISSION'; no persistence, identity or audit.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Interactive Cytoscape transaction graph with evidence dimming and node dossier
implemented_capabilities.notes: A working UI component: typed node styling (account, person, company, device, merchant), risk-scaled nodes, step-driven highlight/dim of nodes and edges, click-to-inspect. It renders static scenario data only.
Latency figures ('8.4 ms' vs '1,420 ms'), line counts and complexity labels are hard-coded marketing numbers, not measurements; the SQL is illustrative and was not run.

implemented_capabilities.capability: FalkorDB seeding of the mule-ring scenario
implemented_capabilities.notes: One CREATE statement builds 5 Account nodes, 1 Device, 1 Merchant, TRANSFERRED_TO{amount,timestamp} and SHARES_DEVICE edges in graph 'financial_crime_graph' after deleting any previous graph. Only scenario 1 is seeded, and nothing in the web app reads this graph. Seed amounts do not reconcile with the '$240,000 laundered' narrative in the README/scenarios.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels (seed_data.py): Account{id,name,risk,balance}, Device{id,model,uuid,risk}, Merchant{id,name,jurisdiction,risk}; UI-only types add person and company. Edges: TRANSFERRED_TO{amount,timestamp}, SHARES_DEVICE, and in the UI OWNS and SHARES_ADDRESS. Cypher shown to the user is illustrative text in scenarios.js, e.g. MATCH path=(a:Account)-[:TRANSFERRED_TO*4..6]->(a) RETURN path and MATCH (a)-[:SHARES_DEVICE]->(d)<-[:SHARES_DEVICE]-(b) WHERE a.id <> b.id. One displayed query uses HAVING, which is not valid Cypher/FalkorDB syntax, confirming the strings are not executed. No algo.* procedures, no parameters.
algorithms: None implemented. Cycle detection, device collision and structuring detection exist only as Cypher text in scenarios.js and as pre-computed highlight lists.
backend_interfaces: None. There is no server; seed_data.py is a standalone script.
frontend_interfaces: React single-page cockpit: Header, Hero (scenario selector), ImpactStrip, GraphCanvas (Cytoscape), ArchitectureDiagram, AgentTimeline (play/step), ObservabilityPanel (Cypher vs SQL toggle), RiskVerdictCard (score gauge, SAR draft, analyst sign-off), NodeDetailModal, DemoScriptModal, AboutSection (limitations), Footer
tests_present: none (take_screenshots.js and verification_screenshots/ are manual visual captures)
security_findings: NO LICENSE FILE in repository: reuse relies solely on the user-attested owner permission
seed_data.py:17-25 - connects to FalkorDB at localhost:6379 without credentials and deletes the graph named financial_crime_graph before seeding (destructive if pointed at a shared instance)
seed_data.py:31-50 - static CREATE query with literal synthetic data; no string concatenation of external input
src/components/RiskVerdictCard.jsx:9-30 - 'analyst sign-off' is a client-side boolean with no authentication; presenting it as FinCEN-style approval is misleading if reused

src/data/scenarios.js - fabricated-looking identities, SSN/IMEI/MAC/IP references and a 'sanctioned UBO' narrative are synthetic (README discloses 100% synthetic) but could be mistaken for real records if lifted into a product
No network calls, no secrets, no eval/exec/pickle found; take_screenshots.js is a local Node script (not executed)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Financial-fraud ring/layering/structuring demos (overlaps gagan-gag/FraudTrace-AI and LENGND123/clearpath's WCC fraud ring in the other batches). This repo adds only the cockpit UI and scripted narrative; no detection logic.
evidence_drift_relevance: NONE - no provenance, temporal validity, supersession or invalidation; only a cosmetic client-side sign-off toggle and static timestamps in the sample transfers.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A polished, dependency-light Cytoscape investigation cockpit (step-synchronised highlighting/dimming, typed node styling, timeline with play/step controls, evidence-linked verdict card) that could be re-skinned over real Kairos graph responses; the detection logic itself is not present.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: none (static React bundle); would need a Kairos API to be non-demo

strategy_rationale: There is no detection engine to merge; the only reusable value is the front-end investigation components, which would have to be rewired to real Kairos graph data and a real approval flow. Without a license file, reuse of even the UI depends on the recorded owner permission.
